description: A blank panel carrying the Geodesics logo, with a hidden clock and a five-note melody

params.text: Sets the rate of the hidden clock that steps the melody, 15 to 960 BPM with 120 BPM at the default

outputs.text: Steps through a five-note melody, one note per beat of the hidden clock, as pitches at one volt per octave

menu: Panel Theme — Use Rack global theme follows Rack's own light and dark setting, while White light edition and Dark matter edition pick one outright
